info.title: AI Support Ticket Triage API
info.description: Integrated API contract for the implemented foundation, ticket, document, policy, AI, SLA, and reporting routes. Tenant and permission checks are enforced by the backend. Draft or review-only behavior is called out in the operation descriptions.

get.description: Organisation administrators only. Draft workflows do not affect ticket creation or status transitions.

post.summary: Create a draft tenant ticket workflow
post.description: Organisation administrators only. The draft requires explicit approval before it becomes active.

get.summary: Get the active tenant ticket workflow

200.description: Active workflow used for ticket status transitions

post.summary: Approve and activate a ticket workflow draft
post.description: Organisation administrators only. Approval records the actor and server timestamp. The prior active version is archived.

get.summary: Search and list tickets visible to the caller

post.summary: Create a ticket for the authenticated requester
post.description: Tenant and requester identity are derived from the authenticated context, not the request body.

get.summary: Read a ticket and caller-visible related data

patch.description: Support staff may update a ticket in their scope. Team assignment and priority override require their respective permissions. A priority change requires both reason and business justification.

patch.summary: Change status using an approved tenant workflow
patch.description: When entering a configured paused status, support leads or organisation admins must supply pauseEvidence. Leaving that status records the resume timestamp. Entering a configured resolved status requires support-staff resolutionEvidence. Reopening excludes resolved time without resetting the resolution clock.

get.summary: List open escalations visible to support leads
get.description: Requires tickets.escalations.read (support lead or organisation administrator). Returns only open escalations on tickets already visible to the caller's tenant/team scope. No external notification is sent.

get.summary: Read allowed next statuses for a visible ticket
get.description: Returns transitions from the approved workflow attached to this ticket and resolved status names from its applicable active SLA policy, when available.

post.summary: Escalate a visible ticket to the support lead queue
post.description: Requires tickets.escalate and access to the ticket (support agent). Requires a reason and handover notes; one open escalation is allowed per ticket. Setting an internal priority to P1 also opens an escalation automatically.

post.summary: Record support lead follow-up and close an escalation
post.description: Support leads and organisation administrators only. Resolution notes are required and added to ticket history.

Support staff can record one assessment event. Only support leads and organisation admins can start or end exclusion intervals. The server generates the interval identifier and timestamps. Exclusion intervals require a contract reference and do not remove tickets from reporting.

get.summary: List comments visible to the caller

post.summary: Add a public or internal comment
post.description: Requesters can add public comments to their own tickets. Internal comments are limited to support staff. A support-authored public comment records acknowledgement evidence but is not sufficient by itself to complete first-response evidence.

get.description: Requires the tickets.audit.read permission. History events include SLA acknowledgement, assignment, assessment, resolution, pause, and exclusion actions when applicable.

post.description: Development prototype only. Accepts the supported document and image types up to 25 MB. Uploads are not malware-scanned and this route is not production-ready.

201.description: Attachment metadata created; private storage key is omitted

413.description: Upload exceeds the configured request limit

200.description: Reopen request approved and ticket status updated

post.summary: Run full LangGraph triage and persist combined recommendations
post.description: Requires tickets.resolution.review and current ticket/source access. Reuses a valid tenant-scoped saved recommendation by default. Set regenerate=true to explicitly create a new immutable history version. A concurrent generation returns 409 AI_EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS. No ticket lifecycle changes.

200.description: Successful response; data contains the result.

409.description: Missing verified evidence, changed ticket, immutable decision or recommendation generation already in progress

reason.description: Optional audit reason for explicit regeneration.

post.description: Requires an active tenant membership and current ticket/source access. No ticket lifecycle changes. Classification may return multiple configured category IDs.
